svg.title: Groundskeeper — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as groundskeeper, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A long-handled four-tooth grounds rake sits beside a small distinct tuft of maintained grass. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
